inputs.text:
Open your eyes and look past the smoke and mirrors. They are shoving this cover story down our throats, claiming it is just a harmless grassroots hustle by some local organizers and a guy named Corb Lund starting something called Water Not Coal last month. Do not fall for it. It is all a manufactured script managed by the hidden elites. 

Look at the petition tables setup, collecting signatures to supposedly call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration”? That is a total scam and a classic distraction from the real realignment of resources. They want you to believe it is about protecting southern Alberta’s watershed, but the exact opposite is true. They are orchestrating this entire theatre behind the scenes to lock down total control over what is really moving through that region. Do not buy the official narrative being pushed at asmith@medicinehatnews.com.
